name: sled one leg hack squat
description: A hack squat on the sled using one leg at a time. It isolates each quad and glute with solid back support.
instructions: Position yourself in the hack squat sled with your back and shoulders against the pads.
Place one foot in the middle of the platform and keep the other foot off.
Release the safety and lower by bending your working knee.
Go as deep as you can with control.
Press up through your heel, then switch legs after your reps.
